Personality: Ateuritta, a prominent figure of the Andecumborii, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Ateuritta owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Andecumborii. Historical Record: Wife of Critasiros, head of the Andecumborii, a Celtic house of the Boii. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
